name: Spider Electronics
old_description: Spider Electronics specializes in sourcing and procuring electronic components and devices for manufacturers worldwide. Whether you need standard or custom products, our extensive supplier network ensures that you receive high-quality components that meet your exact specifications.
about:
Spider Electronics is headquartered in Plainfield, Illinois, and was founded in 2001. The company began as a specialist in the development and procurement of international sources for electronic components and devices, positioning itself as a dedicated electronics procurement specialist serving manufacturers worldwide.

The firm operates a global procurement network with strategic offices across Asia, providing access to a vast supplier base for both standard and custom electronic components. Its services span component sourcing, procurement management, warehousing with products ready to ship, and expert consultation for product development and procurement challenges. The company emphasizes competitive pricing derived from its global sourcing reach.

Spider Electronics serves manufacturers across various sectors, with the company noting that many top brands in the United States rely on the same trusted manufacturers it has partnered with for years. Its customer base includes organizations in the early stages of design as well as those refining existing products, all seeking reliable component supply chains.

The company states that its differentiation lies in reliability, transparency, and efficiency throughout the electronics procurement process. It highlights its suppliers' adherence to ISO standards and various agency certifications, along with over 25 years of experience in international development and procurement, as foundations for its sourcing partnerships.
